D1.rationale: Computer-generated block randomization with allocation concealed in sequentially numbered, opaque, sealed envelopes; baseline characteristics were well balanced.

D2.rationale: Blinding of clinicians was impossible and 2 randomized comparator patients who died during ECMO establishment were excluded from the analysis rather than analysed by assignment (2.6 N). With only 2/104 excluded and 47 deaths observed, the impact is probably not substantial (2.7 PN), so Some concerns rather than High; any bias from excluding early comparator deaths would favour the comparator (towards null).

D3.rationale: Data were available for 102 of 104 randomized patients (98%); the 2 patients without 6-month outcome data were early comparator deaths, and with 47 observed events the missing outcomes could not importantly change the mortality estimate.

D4.rationale: All-cause mortality at 6 months is an objective outcome; although data collectors were unblinded, knowledge of assignment is unlikely to influence ascertainment of death.

D5.rationale: Both pre-specified mortality time points were reported (5.2 N), but no protocol or SAP was available, so 5.1 and 5.3 are NI and selection among analyses cannot be excluded.

overall.rationale: Low risk in D1, D3 and D4, but Some concerns in D2 (post-randomization exclusion of two comparator patients, 2.6 N) and D5 (no pre-specified analysis plan available). No domain is High and the concerns do not substantially lower confidence overall.
